posts.name: Wortwise

posts.description: Wortwise turns German vocabulary into a daily practice habit. Choose A1, A2, B1 or B2, explore topics such as food, work and travel, and practise with flashcards, English meanings, examples, listening and active recall. Use practical missions to connect words to everyday situations, save words for later, and track what needs review. Start at your current level and try it in your browser without signing up.
